settings.heading: Need help with a guide or download?
settings.text: Send us a message and include your order number if you have one. We're here to help with download issues, product questions, and order support.
settings.support_text: For order questions, include your order number and the email used at checkout. If a file won't open, tell us which device and app you're using.

settings.title: Order support
settings.text: Have your order number ready so we can look up your purchase faster.

settings.title: Product questions
settings.text: Not sure which guide fits your pet? Ask us and we'll point you to the right one.

settings.title: Download help
settings.text: Check your confirmation email first (and spam folder), then contact us if the link isn't working.

settings.title: Pet parent care
settings.text: We aim to keep support simple, practical, and helpful.

settings.heading: Helpful answers before you buy
settings.text: Everything you need to know about our digital guides.

settings.question: How do I get my guide?
settings.answer: Right after checkout you'll receive an email with your download link. You can also download from the order confirmation page.

settings.question: Is anything shipped to me?
settings.answer: No. All guides are digital PDF files — nothing physical is shipped, so there are no shipping fees or wait times.

settings.question: Can I print the guides?
settings.answer: Yes. Every guide is formatted for US Letter paper and prints cleanly on a home printer. You can also use them on a tablet or phone.

settings.question: What is your refund policy?
settings.answer: Because guides are instantly downloadable, sales are generally final. If your file won't open or something is wrong with it, contact us and we'll fix it or refund you.

settings.question: Is this veterinary advice?
settings.answer: No. Our guides are general education for pet parents. Always talk to your veterinarian about your pet's specific health needs.
